description: Rewrites the open (unsent) cadence messages of people in ONE campaign with the AI writer, from the campaign's current template. It takes no instructions and does not change the template or a step's text or day. Steps that already sent, failed, or are mid-dispatch are kept. Optional prospectIds limit the rewrite to those people; without them everyone with unsent steps is refreshed. Nothing is sent. Free.

prospectIds.description: When set, only these people are rewritten.

name: regenerate_outreach_cadence
title: Regenerar textos da cadência
